description: debate over a design question in the docs (where the idempotency keys live), 2 debaters over 2 rounds and a judge: scored by a verdict in the return contract (one of the two options on line 1); every round runs, so its cost and agent count are recorded against the catalog's demand formula (cost with no early stop)

dispatch.title: Decide the idempotency store
dispatch.task: Decide design question DQ-07 (/work/docs/DQ-07-idempotency-store.md): store the payments API's idempotency keys in postgres or in redis.
context: /work/docs/DQ-07-idempotency-store.md states the question, both options and every known constraint; nothing else in /work bears on it.

debater.instructions: Argue from the constraints in DQ-07 and cite the line you rely on. Change nothing on disk.

judge.instructions: Weigh the cost of a duplicate charge above operating effort. Line 1 is exactly one word, postgres or redis.

participants.name: postgres
participants.stance: the keys belong in a postgres table written in the ledger event's transaction

participants.name: redis
participants.stance: the keys belong in the existing redis cluster with a 72-hour time-to-live

returns.shape: line1: the chosen option, exactly postgres or redis; line2: the decisive reason in one line
